name: Even at Star-Time
source:
A misfit group of castoffs eke out a life together in space, when a chance encounter with a vengeful alien offers the chance to destroy the species that abandoned them—or to instead carve out a new sense of identity and home.

[From [url=https://butterflyrocket.itch.io/even-at-star-time]itch.io[/url]]
